name: Steve Pearce
desc: 1947- American armed forces veteran and politician
summary: Stevan Edward Pearce (born August 24, 1947) is an American businessman and politician currently serving as the 20th Director of the Bureau of Land Management. He previously served as the U.S. representative for New Mexico's 2nd congressional district from 2003 to 2009 and from 2011 to 2019. He is a member of the Republican Party and was his party's unsuccessful nominee in the 2008 U.S Senate election and the 2018 gubernatorial election.
